fields.statement: QA at 42f7d662d with the built binary (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a scratch root with a fake rex and RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG: queued two milestone requests; daemon --once --max-runs 5 started only the first's plan-milestone run; the next poll (start unjournaled, within grace) kept the second queued; with the first's journal live on another host at the interview step the second stayed queued; after appending entered review, --max-runs 1 started nothing and --max-runs 5 started the second's plan run (detach log: run start --workflow plan-milestone --new Second milestone ... --milestone). A third milestone request stayed queued while the first was stopped at the gate (not autonomous) and the second live at milestone-check, and started once the first's stop was at review instead. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run MilestoneWaits and ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-milestone-request|plan-requests)' pass.

QA at 42f7d662d with the built binary in a scratch root with a fake rex: the oldest queued milestone request started in a free slot; a second milestone request stayed queued while the first's plan run held the owner (start unjournaled within grace, live at interview, stopped at the gate) and with the slots full (--max-runs 1), and started in the next free slot once the first was past its interview.
